name: io.github.chunxiaoxx/nautilus-compass
title: Nautilus Compass Memory
description: Local-first long-term memory for AI agents, with byte-recomputable signed verification receipts.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token — create a free account at https://compass.nautilus.social/signup, then generate a token in the console. Each token is user-scoped.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Semantic + keyword hybrid recall over long-term session memory (BGE-m3 local embeddings).

tools.name: session_search
tools.description: Full-text search across archived session digests.

tools.name: thread_recall
tools.description: Recall one hop along linked memory chains (decisions, corrections, pitfalls).

tools.name: drift_check
tools.description: Score current behavior against stored failure anchors — warns before repeating past mistakes.

tools.name: drift_history
tools.description: History of drift scores and anchor hits per project.

tools.name: feedback_log
tools.description: Append verified user feedback as durable memory facts.
